statement: Sequence-zero segment headers use the fixed zero genesis chain; non-zero retained prefixes may have an unknown pruned predecessor. File replay and audit-head comparisons consume records in the same pass that verifies their record chains and segment joins; a failed scan returns no replay or witness verdict. Replay binds its result to the consumed prefix; incomplete active tails and non-text payloads prevent CLI 0, non-text payloads fence dependent context, and changed sealed-segment lengths refuse verification. Retain at most 128 mismatch examples and 32 insufficient reason prefixes of at most 512 UTF-8 bytes while preserving complete decision totals and separate non-text-record counts. Refuse more than 4096 retained rotated segments, excluding the active file. This does not authenticate the writer or establish an atomic filesystem snapshot.
